scope: Direct-upload c1 hotspot diagnostics, not release acceptance. Attachment startup/stop latency means counters describe an observed phase subset, not exact whole-request costs. Every available slot JSON receipt is retained. Perf data contains frame-pointer code addresses, not raw user stacks. Private runtime configurations and payloads excluded.
encoding: Concatenate listed gzipParts, decode gzip, and verify decoded SHA-256.
